result.summary: Found 1 major issue: a broken image placeholder in the 'Popular right now' section.

issues.description: The first restaurant card in the 'Popular right now' section shows a broken/missing image placeholder (gray box with a crossed-out image icon) instead of an actual restaurant photo for Tokumaru Ramen Bar.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the restaurant image URL is valid and loads correctly. Implement a proper fallback image (e.g., a branded placeholder or default food image) in case the primary image fails to load, rather than showing the broken image icon.
